proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item UnitRecord kind
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no magic_item variant. The taxonomy atom graph lists magic_item_root as a source atom, but types.ts only defines SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. A new top-level kind with its own mechanics family is required before any magic item can be encoded.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Wondrous Item, Very Rare — the item kind is magic_item, which has no corresponding record type in UnitRecord.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_ability_score (permanent)
proposed_widenings.justification: The item permanently raises Dexterity by 2. The taxonomy defers modify_ability_score as 'out-of-scope for the core mechanics graph' (§12). A permanent ability score increase is the entire mechanic of this item; without it no honest trace is possible.
proposed_widenings.evidence: your Dexterity increases by 2, to a maximum of 30

proposed_widenings.name: ResetCadence: century_recharge (consumable magic item)
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is single-use and recharges after 100 years. This is mechanically distinct from short_rest / long_rest / partial_short_full_long cadences. Magic items in this family follow a 'loses magic, regains in N years' lifecycle not representable by any existing RestResetCadence variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The manual then loses its magic but regains it in a century.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: magic_item is not in UnitRecord. Secondary blocker is the permanent ability score increase effect, which the taxonomy explicitly defers as out-of-scope. The century-recharge lifecycle is a third gap. All three would need to be resolved before this item can be encoded honestly.
